records.jp: それが神様の意思ならば！<CR>なーんてね！　うん、いいよ
records.en_original: If the Divine demands it! Just kidding, let's hang out!
records.en_auxiliary: If the Divine demands it! Just kidding, let's hang out!
records.en: If that is the Divine's will!<CR>Just kidding! Yeah, sure.

records.jp: 今日は、どの方角に行くと良さそう？
records.en_original: Which direction should go this time?
records.en_auxiliary: Which direction should go this time?
records.en: Which direction seems good today?

records.jp: 西……な、気がする
records.en_original: West. ...I think.
records.en_auxiliary: West. ...I think.
records.en: West... Kirara thinks.

records.jp: そういえば、この前。雫世界では<CR>神様の声が聞こえないって言ってたよね
records.en_original: That reminds me. You mentioned that you can't hear the Divine in Oasis, right?
records.en_auxiliary: That reminds me. You mentioned that you can't hear the Divine in Oasis, right?
records.en: Come to think of it, you said the other day<CR>you can't hear the Divine's voice in Oasis, right?

records.jp: 今もまだ、ぼわわわんって来ないまま？
records.en_original: Are you still not getting anything?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you still not getting anything?
records.en: Are you still not getting that bwoooom feeling?

records.jp: 来ない。たまに、話しかけてみるけど<CR>何も聞こえない
records.en_original: Nothing. I tried reaching out to it, but heard nothing.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing. I tried reaching out to it, but heard nothing.
records.en: No. Kirara tries talking to it sometimes,<CR>but she doesn't hear anything.

records.jp: あのさ、実際に神様の声が聞こえるって<CR>どんな感じなの？
records.en_original: So what's it like hearing the voice of the Divine?
records.en_auxiliary: So what's it like hearing the voice of the Divine?
records.en: Hey, what does it actually feel like<CR>to hear the Divine's voice?

records.jp: その不思議な力を<CR>お父さんに利用されてたわけっしょ？
records.en_original: You said your father took advantage of you for your power, right?
records.en_auxiliary: You said your father took advantage of you for your power, right?
records.en: Your father exploited that mysterious power,<CR>right?

records.jp: 私だったら、聞こえないほうがいいなーって<CR>思っちゃうんだけど
records.en_original: I don't know if I would want to hear it if that's what would happen.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if I would want to hear it if that's what would happen.
records.en: If it were me, I think I would rather<CR>not be able to hear it.

records.jp: ……それは、何度も考えたことがある
records.en_original: I've thought that many times.
records.en_auxiliary: I've thought that many times.
records.en: ...Kirara has thought that many times.

records.jp: でも、結局聞こえてしまうという事実は変えられない。<CR>だから、大事なのは……
records.en_original: But the fact remains that I cannot change how I am.
records.en_auxiliary: But the fact remains that I cannot change how I am.
records.en: But Kirara can't change the fact that she hears it.<CR>So what matters is...

records.jp: その力を「良いことに使う」か<CR>「悪いことに使う」か
records.en_original: The most important thing is how this power of mine is used.
records.en_auxiliary: The most important thing is how this power of mine is used.
records.en: whether that power is used for good<CR>or used for evil.

records.jp: ……きららのお父さんは、自分の<CR>私利私欲のために使おうとしてたよね
records.en_original: But your dad used it for his own selfish means?
records.en_auxiliary: But your dad used it for his own selfish means?
records.en: ...Your father tried to use it<CR>for his own selfish desires, right?

records.jp: ……うん。でも、この力で<CR>友達や村の危機を救えたのも事実
records.en_original: Yes. However, my power also saved my friends and my home from danger.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. However, my power also saved my friends and my home from danger.
records.en: ...Yes. But it's also true this power<CR>saved Kirara's friends and village from danger.

records.jp: 本当に、使い方次第ってことかあ
records.en_original: I guess it's all in your intentions...
records.en_auxiliary: I guess it's all in your intentions...
records.en: So it really does depend on how it is used.

records.jp: だけど、今はその力は使えないわけだし、<CR>ちょっとは気が楽なんじゃない？
records.en_original: Either way, does it feel like a weight off your shoulders now that you can't use it?
records.en_auxiliary: Either way, does it feel like a weight off your shoulders now that you can't use it?
records.en: But since you cannot use that power right now,<CR>doesn't it make things at least a little easier?

records.jp: 神の声が聞こえないのは、<CR>視力や聴覚、味覚を失うのと同じことだ
records.en_original: It's like becoming unable to taste a delicious meal, or hear a beautiful melody.
records.en_auxiliary: It's like becoming unable to taste a delicious meal, or hear a beautiful melody.
records.en: Not being able to hear the Divine's voice<CR>is the same as losing sight, hearing, or taste.

records.jp: えっ……
records.en_original: Wha...
records.en_auxiliary: Wha...
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: 人は五感。きららは六感。<CR>六感、すべてが揃って、きららだった
records.en_original: Humans have five senses, but I have six. Those six senses make me who I am.
records.en_auxiliary: Humans have five senses, but I have six. Those six senses make me who I am.
records.en: People have five senses. Kirara has six.<CR>Only with all six senses together was Kirara Kirara.

records.jp: 今のきららは……ひとつ足りてない
records.en_original: I am now...incomplete.
records.en_auxiliary: I am now...incomplete.
records.en: The Kirara of now... is missing one.

records.jp: 神の声が聞こえないきららは……<CR>きららじゃない
records.en_original: I feel like a completely different person.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like a completely different person.
records.en: A Kirara who can't hear the Divine's voice...<CR>isn't Kirara.

records.jp: （つい、興味本位で聞いちゃったけど……）
records.en_original: (I was just a little curious, but...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I was just a little curious, but...)
records.en: (I asked out of simple curiosity, but...)

records.jp: （きららにとって、この力は<CR>本当に大切なものだったんだ）
records.en_original: (It seems like Kirara's power is really important to her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It seems like Kirara's power is really important to her.)
records.en: (To Kirara, this power was<CR>something truly important.)

records.jp: ……神の声って便利だなあとか、<CR>軽く考えちゃってごめん
records.en_original: I feel bad for not taking it very seriously... I just thought it must be convenient.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel bad for not taking it very seriously... I just thought it must be convenient.
records.en: ...I'm sorry I took it so lightly,<CR>thinking the Divine's voice was just convenient.

records.jp: 別に、愛央が謝ることではない
records.en_original: You have nothing to apologize for.
records.en_auxiliary: You have nothing to apologize for.
records.en: Ao doesn't need to apologize for that.

records.jp: （力を失って、すごく不安なんだろうな。<CR>だから、予言ぽいことも言っちゃうのかも？）
records.en_original: (It must be scary to lose something you'd taken for granted. Maybe that's why she keeps making her own predictions.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It must be scary to lose something you'd taken for granted. Maybe that's why she keeps making her own predictions.)
records.en: (Losing her power must make Kirara really anxious.<CR>Maybe that's why she still says things that sound like prophecies?)

records.jp: （そうすることで、自分で居続けようとしてる。<CR>だけど私は……）
records.en_original: (She's trying to keep a part of herself that she feels like she's lost...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's trying to keep a part of herself that she feels like she's lost...)
records.en: (By doing that, she is trying to keep being herself.<CR>But I...)

records.jp: （神様がいなくても、きららはきららだと<CR>思うんだけどなあ）
records.en_original: (But she'll always be Kirara to me no matter what.)
records.en_auxiliary: (But she'll always be Kirara to me no matter what.)
records.en: (I still think Kirara is Kirara<CR>even without the Divine.)

records.jp: 交流により新たな工作物を思いつきました。<CR>「<CLGR>タピオカドリンク<CLNR>」のメモリーを手に入れました
records.en_original: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Tapioca Drink<CLNR> memory.
records.en_auxiliary: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Tapioca Drink<CLNR> memory.
records.en: A new crafting idea came to you through your bond.<CR>You obtained the <CLGR>Tapioca Drink<CLNR> memory.
